bokuzukuri.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a teacher lifting a thin stick. The top stroke is the stick, and the lines below fly out as it hits the desk. It gives one sharp <radical form="攵">tap</radical>.
bokuzukuri.image_prompt: A strict teacher lifts a bamboo stick back over one shoulder; that is the stroke at the top. The short bar below is the desk. The two strokes at the bottom fly apart like small pieces of wood as the stick lands with one hard <radical>tap</radical>.
bokuzukuri.description: 攵 has a diagonal plus crossbar on top, then two strokes splaying below like a stick recoiling. 父 peaks into a closed triangle instead, no crossbar. 欠 is one long sweep into a hooked tail, no crossbar, nothing splaying at the bottom.

furutori.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a scruffy bird on a perch, its feathers stacked in rows. Some feathers are missing. It has not flown in years. It is an <radical form="隹">old bird</radical>.
furutori.image_prompt: A stiff vertical perch holds a scruffy bird whose tail feathers are four short horizontal bars stacked like ruffles. One bare patch of skin shows near its feet where feathers fell out. Dust covers it; it has not flown in years. An <radical>old bird</radical>.

gatsuhen.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a cracked bone. A short stroke on top has split off, and the rest bends down and breaks at the joint. A broken bone like this means <radical form="歹">death / bad luck</radical>.
gatsuhen.image_prompt: An old dry bone lies on the ground. A short jagged piece at the top has cracked off, and the rest of the bone sags and snaps clean through at the joint. A black crow sits nearby, a sign of <radical>death / bad luck</radical>.

hane.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like two matching feathers side by side. A duck cleans itself too hard, and two feathers pop off. Each one is a <radical form="羽">feather</radical>.
hane.image_prompt: A surprised duck by a pond pulls too hard while cleaning itself. Two matching feathers pop loose and float down side by side, each with small hooked lines on one center line. Each one is a <radical>feather</radical>.

hatsugashira.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a runner who slips and falls into the splits. His arms fly out and his legs slide far apart. Ouch! Those are <radical form="癶">outspread legs</radical>.
hatsugashira.image_prompt: A runner in a blue shirt and red shorts has slipped into a painful split. His two arms fling straight out to the sides and his two legs slide far apart in running shoes, his face squeezed tight. All that is left is two <radical>outspread legs</radical>.

hitsuji.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like an animal seen from the front. The two short strokes on top are horns, and the lines below are its stiff legs. It stands calmly and chews: a <radical form="羊">sheep</radical>.
hitsuji.image_prompt: Two short strokes flare out at the very top like horns caught on a fence rail. The frame underneath forms four stiff crossed legs that do not bend. The animal just stands there chewing calmly, not bothered at all: a <radical>sheep</radical>.
hitsuji.description: 半 (half) starts straight from the cross-frame, with nothing above it. 羊 adds two short diagonal strokes fanning out above that same frame — those are the horns that make it a sheep, not a half.

hoko.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a long weapon leaning against a gate. It has a curved blade, and a guard's scarf is caught on the tip. The guard walks away, and down falls the <radical form="戈">halberd</radical>.
hoko.image_prompt: A long wooden shaft leans on a castle gate at a steep diagonal. A curved blade hooks off the side of the shaft. A guard walks past, his scarf snags on the tip at the top, pulls tight, and the whole weapon topples with a crash: a <radical>halberd</radical>.

inoko.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like an animal lying on its back. Its four short legs kick in the air, and the little hook is a curly tail. It is an angry <radical form="豕">pig</radical>.
inoko.image_prompt: An animal has been flipped onto its back for a belly rub. Its four short legs shoot straight up and kick at the air, and a small hooked stroke at the back curls into one tight tail. Its face looks offended. It is a very unhappy <radical>pig</radical>.

inu.mnemonic_text: This radical is a combination of <part form="大">big</part> and <part form="丶">drop</part>. A <part form="大">big</part> animal has a <part form="丶">drop</part> on its shoulder. It spins and snaps at it, like any <radical form="犬">dog</radical>.
inu.image_prompt: A big, happy animal stands with its legs spread wide. A single small dot sits high up by its shoulder. The animal spins in a tight circle, snapping at that spot again and again and never reaching it, just like a <radical>dog</radical> chasing its tail.
inu.description: 大 (big) is just the figure with arms out, no extra mark anywhere. 太 (thick / fat) adds its dot low down, between the legs, like a belly bulge. 犬 adds its dot high up, by the shoulder, like the flea it keeps snapping at — the dot's height is the only difference between all three.

itaru.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a dart coming down onto the flat ground at the bottom. It sticks point-first in the floor, still shaking. Watch it <radical form="至">arrive</radical>.
itaru.image_prompt: A dart flies across a room in a slow arc and turns nose-down. Its point sticks into a flat wooden floor, and it stands upright, still shaking. Small motion lines trace the path it took to finally <radical>arrive</radical>.

kokoro.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a cartoon heart. The long curved stroke is its round bottom, and the three dots are heartbeats jumping out. It is a beating <radical form="心">heart</radical>.
kokoro.image_prompt: A long curved stroke swings round on the left and tapers to a point at the bottom, forming the lower half of a cartoon heart. Three short dots bounce above it like heartbeats that have not settled yet. The whole shape is a beating <radical>heart</radical>.

koromohen.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a shirt on a hanger. A collar is on top, the body drops down, and a sleeve flaps out and hits the clerk. It is <radical form="衤">clothing (left)</radical>.
koromohen.image_prompt: A shirt on a hanger swings on a spinning dry-cleaner rack. The collar hooks out at the top, the straight body of the shirt drops down, and one sleeve flares sideways and smacks the surprised clerk in the face. It is a piece of <radical>clothing (left)</radical>.

madare.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a roof built into the side of a cliff. The dot is the top of the rock, and the roof slopes down over open air with no floor. It is a small <radical form="广">shelter</radical>.
madare.image_prompt: A tall rock cliff. A single dot marks the clifftop, a short beam sticks out from the rock, and a wide roof sweeps down diagonally over open air. It is a lean-to nailed straight into the rock face, with nothing underneath for a floor: a small <radical>shelter</radical>.
madare.description: 广 is a bare lean-to: dot, beam, sweeping eave, open underneath. 疒 draws the same roof but adds two extra strokes tucked inside, like something lying under the eave. 尸 drops the dot and folds into one bent stroke, like a seated figure's back and leg — no roof.

mata.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a right hand reaching into a cookie jar. The lid shuts, and the same hand comes back <radical form="又">again</radical>.
mata.image_prompt: A right hand reaches into a cookie jar. The hooked stroke at the top is the bent knuckles, and the long stroke is the arm stretching down. The jar lid has just shut, and the same right hand slides back in <radical>again</radical>.

mu.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a small closed loop. A silkworm spins itself inside that loop and hides in its own <radical form="厶">cocoon</radical>.
mu.image_prompt: The short first stroke curls shut, and the long second stroke sweeps around to close the gap, making a small sealed loop. A silkworm spins thread around itself inside that loop, wrapping tighter until it disappears into its own <radical>cocoon</radical>.

nari.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like the tail of a snake. The snake has gone into a crack in the wall, and only its curled tail is left. It does nothing. It just continues <radical form="也">to be</radical>.
nari.image_prompt: A snake has almost finished going into a crack in a wall. Only the last loop of its tail is still outside, hooked back on itself and holding very still. It is not going anywhere or doing anything, just continuing <radical>to be</radical>.

nisui.mnemonic_text: This radical is two short strokes, one above the other. They are two chips of frost that a scraper pulls off a car window. Both are hard <radical form="冫">ice</radical>.
nisui.image_prompt: A hand drags a scraper across a frosty car windshield. Two curls of frost come off, a short one above and a longer hooked one below, and they hang in the air, frozen solid as two chunks of <radical>ice</radical>.

oigashira.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a bent person with a cane. The top stroke is white hair, and the long slanted stroke is the cane. A slow man crosses the road while a car waits. He is <radical form="耂">old</radical>.
oigashira.image_prompt: A stooped man with white tufts of hair shuffles slowly across a zebra crossing, bent forward over a long cane. A small car waits patiently behind him. His bent back and slanted cane follow the strokes of the shape. He is <radical>old</radical>.

ono.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like an axe stuck in a chopping block. The top stroke is the blade, and the long stroke is the handle. The woodcutter cannot pull out his <radical form="斤">axe</radical>.
ono.image_prompt: A woodcutter pulls at an axe stuck deep in a chopping block. The top stroke is the tilted axe head, and the long hooked stroke below is the handle. He missed the log and the blade is stuck. The stump keeps the <radical>axe</radical>.

oogai.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a head lying flat on an open book, with two short legs hanging off the bottom. Someone fell asleep while reading. Their <radical form="頁">head</radical> is stuck to the page.
oogai.image_prompt: An open notebook on a desk. A person has fallen asleep reading: their wide face lies flat on the paper, one cheek squashed, and two short legs dangle off the bottom edge of the page. The sleeping <radical>head</radical> fills the page.

ou-king.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like three flat crowns stacked up, with one spike going down through them. A king wears the stack so it cannot slide off. Gems shine on the bottom crown: <radical form="王">king / jewel</radical>.
ou-king.image_prompt: Three flat gold crowns are stacked one on top of another. A single iron spike goes straight down through all three to hold them together on a king's head. The bottom crown is covered in shining gems, for <radical>king / jewel</radical>.
ou-king.description: 主 (lord) adds a short diagonal dot above the top bar, like a lit candle flame. 王 has no such mark — just three plain, level bars joined by one straight vertical.

sato.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like square rice fields sitting on a thick layer of earth. Fields and land together make a <radical form="里">village</radical>.
sato.image_prompt: A grid of square rice paddies, neatly divided by paths, sits on top of a thick flat slab of packed brown earth. A few small farm houses stand at the edges. The fields and the land under them make up the <radical>village</radical>.

shikabane.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a person lying face down with one leg kicked out. He fell asleep on the floor at a party hours ago. The guests step around the <radical form="尸">body</radical>.
shikabane.image_prompt: A party in a Japanese room with tatami floor. A man lies face down on the tatami, bent over, one leg kicked out to the side. He has not moved for hours. Guests in party clothes carefully step around the sprawled <radical>body</radical>.
shikabane.description: 戸 (door) is the same shape with one extra short stroke lying across the top. 广 (cliff / shelter) has a dot on top and only a roof line with a wall under it; it has no closed box.

shikigamae.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a post hammered into the ground, with a short peg near the top. A banner is tied to the peg. This <radical form="弋">stake</radical> marks the spot for tonight's ceremony.
shikigamae.image_prompt: A single wooden post is hammered straight into a town square. A short diagonal peg sticks out near its top, and a colourful banner is knotted onto it, flapping in the wind. The planted <radical>stake</radical> marks the ground for tonight's ceremony.

to-dipper.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a long ladle full of flour, with two bits of flour flying off. A tiny baker holds its long handle. He measures flour with this <radical form="斗">dipper</radical>.
to-dipper.image_prompt: A big grey ladle lies across the picture, its scoop on the left heaped with white flour. A long grey handle stands straight up across it, and a tiny smiling baker in a white cap and blue apron holds its top. Two bits of flour fly off to the upper left. It is a measuring <radical>dipper</radical>.

tobira.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a wooden door frame. The short stroke on top is a loose piece of the door. A raccoon pushes through underneath. It is a <radical form="戸">door</radical>.
tobira.image_prompt: A wooden door frame: a flat top beam with a short loose board tilted on top of it, a long bent post on the left and a short post on the right. A raccoon pushes its way through the opening underneath. This is a <radical>door</radical>.
tobira.description: 尸 is the same bent frame without that extra stroke — just a horizontal roof over a long hooking body line, like a slumped figure with nothing above it. 戸 adds the short diagonal tick at the top-left corner, the door panel catching on its hinge, which 尸 never has.

tori-bird.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a pigeon on a windowsill. Its head is tucked in at the top. Four thin legs stick out below and tap on the glass. It is a clumsy <radical form="鳥">bird</radical>.
tori-bird.image_prompt: A pigeon with its head ducked into a hunched wing lands stiffly on a windowsill. Under its body, four skinny stick legs splay out and clatter against the glass. The whole awkward, top-heavy shape is a <radical>bird</radical>.

tsutsumu.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a hooked stroke curling around something. A too-small sheet of paper curls over a big watermelon. It barely covers it, but it is still a <radical form="勹">wrap</radical>.
tsutsumu.image_prompt: A curved, hooked sheet of gift paper curls over the top and down the right side of a large watermelon on a counter. The sheet is much too small, so one edge only just overlaps. The lopsided parcel is still a <radical>wrap</radical>.

uo.mnemonic_text: This radical is made of <part form="𠂊">crouch</part>, <part form="田">rice field</part> and <part form="灬">fire (bottom)</part>. A man <part form="𠂊">crouches</part> in a wet <part form="田">rice field</part> and grabs his dinner. He cooks it over a <part form="灬">fire</part>. It is a <radical form="魚">fish</radical>.
uo.image_prompt: At the top, a man crouches low at the edge of a flooded rice field, grabbing a wriggling fish from the water. The square rice field fills the middle. At the bottom, a small campfire with four flames grills the <radical>fish</radical> on a stick.

wakanmuri.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a blanket thrown over a sleeping cat. The flat top lies across, and the two short sides tuck in the edges. Nothing pokes out. It is a <radical form="冖">cover</radical>.
wakanmuri.image_prompt: A cat curled up asleep on a wooden porch, completely hidden under a thrown blanket. The blanket lies flat across the top, and its two ends droop down only a little on each side, just enough to tuck in the edges. Not even the tail pokes out. A snug <radical>cover</radical>.
wakanmuri.description: 冂 is tall and open — its two vertical sides run most of the character's height, like a doorway frame with nothing under it. 冖's sides are short, barely drooping below the top stroke at all, more lid than frame.

ya.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like an arrow. The short strokes at the top are feathers, and the lines at the bottom are the sharp point. It is stuck in a pumpkin. A stray <radical form="矢">arrow</radical>!
ya.image_prompt: At a fair, an arrow has missed the target. Two short strokes at the top are feathers on the shaft, the line drops straight down, then splits into a sharp point. The point pins a vendor's pumpkin to a fence, still shaking. A stray <radical>arrow</radical>.

yamaidare.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a slanted roof with two small marks by the wall. Under the roof, a man shakes so hard that his thermometer snaps in two. This house is full of <radical form="疒">sickness</radical>.
yamaidare.image_prompt: A small house drawn with a dot on top, a long flat roof, and a wall slanting down on the left, with two short tick marks beside that wall. Under the roof, a pale man in a blanket shivers so hard that the thermometer in his hand snaps in two. The whole room shows <radical>sickness</radical>.
yamaidare.description: Both have a dot over a long roof and a wall slanting down on the left. This radical adds two short ticks on the left side of that wall. 广 (cliff / shelter) has no ticks.
